remarks: Welcome to effortless living in the heart of Mid-City Stamford. This beautifully renovated and oversized 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence offers the perfect blend of space, style, and convenience. Sunlight pours into the expansive living areas, highlighting the thoughtfully updated interiors and creating a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. The open layout features generously sized rooms, an abundance of closet space, and the added comfort of a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings at home. Step outside to your own private balcony, ideal for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. The convenience of in-unit laundry, a dedicated parking space, and separate storage, adds to the ease of everyday living. Located just moments from Stamford's vibrant downtown, you'll enjoy unbeatable access to top restaurants, shopping, gyms, major highways, and Metro-North-making commuting and entertainment seamless. A rare opportunity for refined, low-maintenance living in one of Stamford's most desirable and convenient neighborhoods. No pets permitted.
